body: A Claude Desktop session is writing the report's method into playbook/README.md as a new section, "Sound by measure and match" (specs at sfxr scale, what a MAME capture holds, corrected waveform/noise/rate/bit-depth reading, the speech path), with a decisions row and a remake-approach row for the earlier method written from memory. It is editing the main checkout directly and uncommitted; VectorCraft's Code session lands it as its own commit through avoid-ai-writing and the Codex review once those edits stop, separate from today's rule edits. First application here: the third author for Asteroids Deluxe's seven POKEY sounds (sequences still empty behind the provenance fence) follows that section; then Star Castle's sounds. BewareILive reads the same report against its #27 placeholders.
summary: Sound report: the method is being written into VectorCraft's playbook ("Sound by measure and match") by the Desktop session; lands as its own reviewed commit; Deluxe's seven sounds apply it first
